title: EvaluationParameters
description: The values of the evaluation protocol's section 10 parameters (ADR-010 section 6), as a reviewed config record. Every ratio is an integer in parts per million (ppm). The profile cannot relate fields, so the reader derives and checks the rest: alpha' = alpha / (family_size * b_sealed) must be a whole number of ppm, b_boot exceeds family_size * b_sealed / alpha, r_cov is at least 1 / alpha', the coverage tolerance is cov_tol_se_multiple times the Monte Carlo standard error (derived, never stored), and the sorted-and-unique rules. The measured entries (n_teams_floor, n_teams, n_seeds, d_team) are null until Wave 4 measures them; a record with a null, or a d_team still at its starting value, is provisional and cannot be registered in a plan. A change is a new parameters_version, never an edit; the record is referenced only by the SHA-256 of its JCS bytes.

parameters_version.description: Bumped by every change; a registered plan names the record by hash.

alpha_ppm.description: Familywise error rate per sealed set (alpha), in ppm.

family_size.description: Number of registered gate claims (m); the TrainingGateRule lists exactly this many.

half_width_ppm.description: Target half-width of the two-sided interval at alpha' per gate. The reader checks each is at most what the gate rule's target power allows (ADR-010 section 6.1 step 2).

g2.description: h for each G2 claim (scripted baselines), in ppm.

g3.description: h for each G3 claim (held-out reference), in ppm.

g3b.description: h for each G3b claim (training progress), in ppm.

n_teams_floor.description: Smallest allowed number of sealed teams; null until measured on validation.

n_teams.description: Sealed teams; null until measured; at least the floor.

n_seeds.description: Seeds per team pair; null until measured.

cov_tol_se_multiple.description: cov_tol is this many Monte Carlo standard errors of the coverage estimate; the reader derives it.

n_stratum_min.description: Smallest stratum cell in each split (protocol D20, erratum E1); at least 2.

differing_fields.description: Near-duplicate distance for L2: teams differing in fewer fields are near-duplicates.

basis.description: starting_value until the first validation measurement replaces it.

battle_decision.description: Per battle decision, on the evaluation hardware.

preview_decision.description: Per Team Preview decision, on the evaluation hardware.

sigma_prior_ppm.description: Prior scale of the rating fit (D17), in ppm of a natural-log unit.

max_turns.description: Turn cap passed to runBattle explicitly by the harness, never taken from the runner's default.

baselines.description: Scripted baseline opponent ids (pool B), sorted and unique (a reader rule).

seen_lineages.description: Lineages whose frozen checkpoints are seen opponents (pool F), sorted and unique.

held_out_lineages.description: Lineages whose frozen checkpoints are held out (pool F), sorted and unique, disjoint from seen_lineages.

min_exploiters.description: Fewest evaluation exploiters (pool X) per candidate.
